create_HYV3ReasoningParser: create an HYV3ReasoningParser instance with a tokenizer and reasoning_effort setting
extract_reasoning_content: extract reasoning and content from a model output string using the HYV3ReasoningParser
extract_reasoning_streaming: extract streaming reasoning deltas from incremental model output chunks
check_reasoning_end: check whether input token IDs indicate the end of a reasoning block
extract_content_ids: extract non-reasoning content token IDs from a full input token sequence
